players.name: Nick Muse
players.summary: Muse (shoulder) was a limited participant in Monday's estimated practice, Tori McElhaney of the Falcons' official site reports.

players.name: Tua Tagovailoa
players.summary: Tagovailoa (ankle) was estimated as a limited participant in Monday's walk-through practice, Marc Raimondi of ESPN.com reports.

players.name: Brian Robinson Jr.
players.summary: Robinson was listed as a limited participant in Monday's walkthrough practice due to an ankle injury, Marc Raimondi of ESPN.com reports.

players.name: Zay Flowers
players.summary: Ravens head coach Jesse Minter said Monday that Flowers (hamstring) has a "good shot" to play Week 3 in Dallas, Ryan Mink of the Ravens' official site reports.

players.name: Ja'Kobi Lane
players.summary: Coach Jesse Minter said Lane underwent wrist surgery Wednesday, and the Ravens placed the rookie wide receiver on injured reserve, Brian Wacker of The Baltimore Sun reports.

players.name: Ty Johnson
players.summary: out

players.name: DJ Moore
players.summary: The Bills are treating Moore as day-to-day after he was diagnosed with an AC joint sprain in his shoulder after exiting Thursday's 41-31 win over the Lions, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.

players.name: Jonathon Brooks
players.summary: Brooks is considered week-to-week while he receives further medical opinions on the groin injury he sustained in Sunday's 34-3 win over the Falcons, Tom Pelissero of Netflix reports.

players.name: Caleb Williams
players.summary: Bears head coach Ben Johnson said that he doesn't anticipate Williams (hamstring) practicing in Week 3, though Johnson was unwilling to officially rule out the quarterback from playing Monday against the Eagles, Sean Hammond of the Chicago Tribune reports.

players.name: Dylan Sampson
players.summary: Sampson (knee) was placed on injured reserve Tuesday.

players.name: Dillon Gabriel
players.summary: ir

players.name: Marvin Mims Jr.
players.summary: out

players.name: RJ Harvey
players.summary: out

players.name: J.K. Dobbins
players.summary: The Broncos believe that Dobbins' injured hamstring is "good" heading into next Sunday's game against the Rams, Tom Pelissero of Netflix reports.

players.name: Caleb Lohner
players.summary: Lohner (lower body) was placed on injured reserve by the Broncos on Sunday with a designation to return, Aric DiLalla of the team's official website reports.

players.name: Jayden Reed
players.summary: The Packers listed Reed (back) as a non-participant on Monday's estimated practice report, Tom Silverstein of the Milwaukee Journal Sentinel reports.

players.name: Nico Collins
players.summary: out

players.name: Alec Pierce
players.summary: Pierce will try to rehab his injured left heel without surgery and is expected to miss several weeks before potentially returning around midseason if all goes well, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.

players.name: DJ Giddens
players.summary: out

players.name: Ashton Dulin
players.summary: out

players.name: Carson Towt
players.summary: ir

players.name: Sean McKeon
players.summary: questionable

players.name: D.J. Montgomery
players.summary: Montgomery (abdomen) was placed on injured reserve by the Colts on Sunday, JJ Stankevitz of the team's official website reports.

players.name: Jimmy Holiday
players.summary: Holiday (undisclosed) was placed on injured reserve by the Chiefs on Sunday.

players.name: Brock Bowers
players.summary: Raiders head coach Klint Kubiak said that Bowers (knee) will practice this week and is gearing up to play Sunday against the Saints, Levi Edwards of the team's official site reports.

players.name: Aidan O'Connell
players.summary: out

players.name: Dareke Young
players.summary: Young (hamstring) is questionable to return to Sunday's game against the Chargers.

players.name: Charlie Kolar
players.summary: Head coach Jim Harbaugh said Monday that Kolar will go on injured reserve due to a forearm injury he sustained during Sunday's 26-14 loss to the Raiders, Kris Rhim of ESPN.com reports.

players.name: David Njoku
players.summary: Head coach Jim Harbaugh told reporters Monday that Njoku (fibula) and Charlie Kolar (forearm) will both go on injured reserve, Kris Rhim of ESPN.com reports.

players.name: KeAndre Lambert-Smith
players.summary: The Chargers placed Lambert-Smith (hamstring) on injured reserve Tuesday.

players.name: Puka Nacua
players.summary: Rams head coach Sean McVay acknowledged Tuesday that he's uncertain if Nacua (groin) will be available for Sunday's game against the Broncos, Gary Klein of the Los Angeles Times reports. "I'm not sure what his status is as far as this next coming week," McVay said of Nacua. "I'm hopeful that he'll play.... If he's ready to go, great. If not, then we'll continue to roll."

players.name: Ronnie Rivers
players.summary: Rivers has been ruled out for the remainder of Monday's game against the Giants due to a calf injury.

players.name: Ty Simpson
players.summary: Simpson (coach's decision) is inactive but will serve as the Rams' emergency third quarterback for Monday's game against the Giants.

players.name: Jordan Whittington
players.summary: Whittington (quadriceps) is inactive for Monday's game against the Giants.

players.name: CJ Daniels
players.summary: inactive

players.name: Jaylen Wright
players.summary: Wright (neck) is day-to-day heading into Week 3, David Furones of the South Florida Sun Sentinel reports.

players.name: Caleb Douglas
players.summary: Dolphins head coach Jeff Hafley said Monday that it's "too early to tell" the severity of the ankle injury Douglas sustained in Sunday's 35-13 loss to the 49ers, C. Isaiah Smalls II of the Miami Herald reports.

players.name: Jauan Jennings
players.summary: out

players.name: Jordan Mason
players.summary: ir

players.name: Eli Raridon
players.summary: Raridon (thigh) has been ruled out for the remainder of Sunday's game against the Steelers.

players.name: Jaxson Dart
players.summary: Dart is believed to have suffered a sprained MCL in his left knee during Monday's 28-6 loss to the Rams, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.

players.name: Malik Nabers
players.summary: Nabers left Monday's game against the Rams with an apparent right arm injury and is questionable to return, Ralph Vacchiano of FoxSports.com reports.

players.name: Thomas Fidone II
players.summary: inactive

players.name: Arian Smith
players.summary: questionable

players.name: Kene Nwangwu
players.summary: out

players.name: Mason Taylor
players.summary: Taylor (thumb) is questionable to return to Sunday's game against the Packers, Zack Rosenblatt of The Athletic reports.

players.name: Omar Cooper Jr.
players.summary: The Jets are expected to place Cooper (ankle) on injured reserve, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.

players.name: Dallas Goedert
players.summary: Goedert (knee) was diagnosed Monday with a sprained MCL and is expected to miss a few weeks, Ian Rapoport and Adam Schefter of ESPN report.

players.name: Saquon Barkley
players.summary: The Eagles announced that Barkley (neck/shoulder) is questionable to return to Sunday's game against the Titans due to a stinger.

players.name: Eli Stowers
players.summary: The Eagles placed Stowers (quadriceps/hamstring) on injured reserve Saturday.

players.name: Michael Pittman Jr.
players.summary: Steelers head coach Mike McCarthy said Monday that Pittman's foot injury is not related to the one he dealt with during training camp and the preseason, Nick Farabaugh of PennLive.com reports.

players.name: Rico Dowdle
players.summary: Dowdle has been ruled out for the remainder of Sunday's game against the Patriots, Brooke Pryor of ESPN.com reports. He finished with seven carries for 22 yards and two catches for 22 yards on two targets.

players.name: Demarcus Robinson
players.summary: San Francisco head coach Kyle Shanahan said that Robinson is facing a recovery timeline of 3-to-6 weeks after sustaining a high-ankle sprain in Sunday's 35-13 win over the Dolphins, Nick Wagoner of ESPN.com reports.

players.name: Mike Evans
players.summary: San Francisco head coach Kyle Shanahan said that Evans (hip) will "have to be managed this week" leading up to Sunday's game against the Cardinals, Nick Wagoner of ESPN.com reports.

players.name: Brandon Aiyuk
players.summary: Head coach Kyle Shanahan said Sunday that he's not viewing Aiyuk as an option for the 49ers while the club contends with multiple injuries at receiver, Matt Barrows of The Athletic reports.

players.name: De'Zhaun Stribling
players.summary: The 49ers placed Stribling (ankle) on injured reserve Saturday.

players.name: Jake Tonges
players.summary: Tonges (knee) requires surgery for an MCL tear and is done for the season, Cam Inman reports.

players.name: Jadarian Price
players.summary: Coach Mike Macdonald said Monday that Price suffered a shoulder injury during Sunday's win at Arizona, but "it's intact and nothing serious, it seems like," Brady Henderson of ESPN.com reports.

players.name: Sam Darnold
players.summary: Darnold (glute) is ahead of schedule in his recovery and has a chance to practice ahead of Seattle's Week 3 road game against the Commanders, head coach Mike Macdonald said after Sunday's 31-7 victory over the Cardinals, Curtis Crabtree of Fox 13 Seattle reports.

players.name: Zach Charbonnet
players.summary: Coach Mike Macdonald said Friday that the Seahawks are drawing closer to setting a date for Charbonnet (knee) to resume practicing, Gregg Bell of The Tacoma News Tribune reports.

players.name: David Sills V
players.summary: Sills (undisclosed) was placed on injured reserve by the Buccaneers on Sunday with a designation to return, Scott Smith of the team's official website reports.

players.name: Jayden Daniels
players.summary: Daniels (elbow) underwent imaging Monday and will consult with multiple experts over the next few days, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.

players.name: Chig Okonkwo
players.summary: out
